# Repair: ELocker internal mechanism stuck

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Inspect differential plate seating, check for failed switches or stuck teeth, and manually wiggle carrier housing. [t123]

## Tips & gotchas

- Check if a failed plunger switch or stuck teeth are preventing disengagement. [t123]
- Manually wiggle the carrier housing teeth apart with a small screwdriver inserted into the three holes to free the mechanism. [t123]
